auth_details: API key via query parameter `key` (e.g. ?key=YOUR_API_KEY); self-serve at account.shodan.io. Some clients also accept key in headers depending on client library.
free_tier_limits: Free plan: 0 API query credits (no REST API access). Membership (paid) required for API query credits; higher plans add filters, streaming, and scan credits—see shodan.io/pricing and account plan.
paid_plans: Membership and enterprise plans with higher query credits, filters, and streaming; see shodan.io/pricing
rate_limits: Plan-dependent; published limits tied to query credits and scan credits—see developer docs and account plan.
description: Shodan is an internet-wide search engine that indexes banners and metadata from exposed devices and services. Its REST API lets developers query hosts, search by filters, look up DNS and ports, stream data, and manage scans—used for attack-surface discovery, asset inventory, and vulnerability research.
resolution_notes: Initial entry from prior verification; settling auditor disputes against live official sources.
